title: The kb MCP server's new and gate add tools file an item and a gate with the CLI's class and repro refusals
goal: With KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS=1 the kb MCP server lists backlog_new (kind, title, parent, sprint, priority, rank, goal, severity, repro, repro_reason, commit and trailer, with check, touch, depends and external as arrays) and backlog_gate_add (id, question, option and do as arrays, recommendation, kind, gate_id, host_check), each run in-process like the claim tool; gate add through the tool prints the same text as the command line, class and disposition lines included, and writes the same item file on a copy; new bug without a failing repro and new of an unknown kind are tool errors that write nothing, and a successful new returns the new item's id and title in its text

run: import sys,os,subprocess,tempfile,shutil,json,glob;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");os.environ["KB_BACKLOG_WRITE_TOOLS"]="1";[os.environ.pop(k,None) for k in ("CLAUDECODE","CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION")];import kb_mcp;R=os.getcwd();a=tempfile.mkdtemp();b=a+"-twin";g=lambda *x:subprocess.run(["git","-C",a,*x],check=True,capture_output=True);g("init","-q");g("config","user.email","a@example.com");g("config","user.name","n");cli=lambda r,*x:subprocess.run([sys.executable,R+"/_tools/backlog.py","--root",r,*x],capture_output=True,text=True,env=dict(os.environ,CLAUDECODE="1"));iid=cli(a,"new","story","--title","Planted","--goal","g","--touch","x/*","--check","true").stdout.split()[2];g("add","-A");g("commit","-qm","plant");shutil.copytree(a,b);call=lambda n,**k:kb_mcp.handle({"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":n,"arguments":k}})["result"];files=lambda r:[open(f).read() for f in sorted(glob.glob(r+"/_backlog/*.json"))];c1=cli(a,"gate","add",iid,"--question","Pick the format?","--option","A","--option","B","--recommendation","A");os.chdir(b);t1=call("backlog_gate_add",id=iid,question="Pick the format?",option=["A","B"],recommendation="A");assert (c1.returncode==0)==(not t1["isError"]),("gate parity",c1,t1);assert files(a)==files(b),"gate add wrote different item files";assert c1.stdout.strip()==t1["content"][0]["text"].strip(),(c1.stdout,t1);n=call("backlog_new",kind="story",title="Second planted",goal="g");assert not n["isError"] and "new story ST-" in n["content"][0]["text"],n;before=files(b);bad=[call("backlog_new",kind="bug",title="No repro",severity="S3"),call("backlog_new",kind="saga",title="x")];assert all(x["isError"] for x in bad),bad;assert files(b)==before,"a refused new wrote"
